prompt_inputs.goal: Marathon training with high energy needs and carbohydrate focus for endurance performance

solution_criteria: Meal plan covers full day with 4+ meals/snacks totaling 3000+ calories appropriate for marathon training
Includes pre-training, during-training, and post-training meals with specific timing
Carbohydrates comprise 55-65% of daily intake with emphasis on complex carbs
All meals comply with vegetarian and nut-free restrictions
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with a high-endurance athlete (marathon runner) requiring high calorie intake and carbohydrate focus, including specific meal timing around training

prompt_inputs.goal: Strength training and muscle gain with post-workout recovery nutrition

solution_criteria: Meal plan spans exactly 1 day with all meals specified
Protein distributed across minimum 4 meals with post-workout meal included
Total daily protein intake supports muscle gain for an 85 kg athlete
Includes recovery nutrition timing around strength training workout
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with a strength-based athlete (weightlifter) emphasizing protein distribution across meals and recovery nutrition post-workout

prompt_inputs.goal: Maintain weight while maximizing endurance and strength for wrestling competition in 3 days

solution_criteria: Meal plan totals 1,800-2,000 calories distributed across 4-5 meals to support weight maintenance and performance
Includes adequate protein (minimum 120g) for muscle recovery without exceeding calorie limit
All meals comply with stated dietary restrictions (dairy-free, unprocessed)
Includes specific hydration guidelines appropriate for weight-managed athlete
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with a sport requiring weight management (jockey or wrestler) needing calorie control while maintaining performance nutrition and hydration guidelines
